scripts.build_docker: npm run build && docker build --no-cache=true -t us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/ejfexperiments/ejfexperiments/common_backend:$npm_package_version -f Dockerfile . && npm run bip
scripts.build_docker_fast: npm run build && docker build --no-cache=true -t us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/ejfexperiments/ejfexperiments/common_backend:$npm_package_version -f DockerfileFast . && npm run bip
scripts.auth: gcloud auth print-access-token | docker login -u oauth2accesstoken --password-stdin https://us-central1-docker.pkg.dev
scripts.publish: npm run auth && docker push us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/ejfexperiments/ejfexperiments/common_backend:$npm_package_version && npm run bip
scripts.publish_nogales: npm run auth && npm run rename_nogales && docker push us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/local-volt-431316-m2/nogales/common_backend:$npm_package_version && npm run bip
